command:
vllm serve MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2.5 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
  --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"PIECEWISE"}' \
  --max-num-seqs 512 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 32768 \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  --moe-backend triton \
  --attention-backend FLASHINFER \
  --enable-flashinfer-autotune \
  --tool-call-parser minimax_m2 \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --reasoning-parser minimax_m2
docker_command:
docker run --gpus all \
  --privileged --ipc=host -p 8000:8000 \
  -v ~/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface \
  -e PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 \
  -e VLLM_USE_DEEP_GEMM=0 \
  -e VLLM_BLOCKSCALE_FP8_GEMM_FLASHINFER=0 \
  -e VLLM_FLOAT32_MATMUL_PRECISION=high \
  -e VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND=1 \
  vllm/vllm-openai:v0.28.0 MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2.5 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
  --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"PIECEWISE"}' \
  --max-num-seqs 512 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 32768 \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  --moe-backend triton \
  --attention-backend FLASHINFER \
  --enable-flashinfer-autotune \
  --tool-call-parser minimax_m2 \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --reasoning-parser minimax_m2

strategy_spec.name: single_node_tp
strategy_spec.description: Single-node tensor parallel. Splits the model across all local GPUs. TP size is set to the GPU count at deploy time. The simplest multi-GPU strategy — works for all model architectures.
